I tried it — pasted the link and hit Save, and yes, this is exactly the feeling I wanted. It went off and gathered the title, a description, the site's little icon, and showed me where it's from, all without me typing any of it. And the card reads nicely at a glance rather than being a raw web address. That's the whole point for me, so this feels right.

The layout works for me too — the save box sitting right up top where I land, and each saved thing showing up as its own readable card underneath. No complaints there.

One small thing I want to make sure we don't lose track of, though it's not for right now: sometimes the title a page gives itself isn't great, so at some point I'll want to be able to tweak the title or description on a saved card myself. But for what you're showing me here — save it fast and get back a clean, readable card with the details filled in — yes, that's what I expect. Nicely done.
